foundation_acceptance.gaia_only_change: gaia_id may differ exactly as v094q recorded; source_id and all coordinates/photometry/flags must not change
foundation_acceptance.legacy_npz: all 1,386 legacy NPZ files must match the frozen v094i inventory hashes and row counts
foundation_acceptance.repaired_npz: all 1,386 v094q repaired caches must match the v094q repaired-cache inventory; compared with legacy, all arrays except gaia_id must have identical names, shape, dtype, and values

diagnostics: old GMST/alt0 vs corrected baseline direction and length
baseline sweep across each permitted event-time interval
DeltaT and polar-motion uncertainty propagated to the geometric quantities used for matching

reference_precision_rules.generator: Time-dependent epipolar generator criterion is minimum cross-track <=7 arcsec over the allowed overlap intervals.
reference_precision_rules.nominal_synthetic_recovery: For every generated jointly observable injection, the time-dependent search must recover the pair with final cross-track <=2 arcsec, ray closure <=2 arcsec, positive rays, geocentric distance >= Earth radius, and recovered distance within 1 percent of truth.
reference_precision_rules.published_eop_deltat: Propagate C01 X/Y published errors and historical DeltaT published error through the actual stereo closure/cross-track quantities.
reference_precision_rules.site_datum: Report ±107 m site-height sensitivity separately; because APPLAUSE coordinate datum/accuracy is undocumented, final precision certification remains site-metadata-qualified.
reference_precision_rules.time_search: Search each allowed overlap interval continuously via deterministic subdivided bounded minimization; event truth time is not supplied to the recovery search.

synthetic_recovery.check: pass through the complete proposed time-dependent geometry/generator/acceptance path, not just a cross-track proxy
synthetic_recovery.distances: predeclared finite-distance grid including near-Earth and larger geocentric distances
synthetic_recovery.event_times: span start, interior, and end of validated overlap intervals
synthetic_recovery.field_positions: span multiple positions inside the jointly observable side-specific footprints
synthetic_recovery.objects: finite-distance events that are simultaneously above both observatory horizons and inside each plate's own footprint
synthetic_recovery.success_output: recovery fraction and failure reason by distance/time/field-position strata

population.source_pairing: none in operational preparation or geometry validation
population.timing_intervals: v094q-independent exposure/exposure_sub reconstruction, already validated against the frozen plan
population.timing_population: the 1,081 independently validated OVERLAP opportunities from v094q

purpose: Establish whether the historical plate opportunities support the geometric precision required for a finite-distance two-observatory search, before any rebuilt matcher or candidate inspection.

applause_plate_geometry: VOTable QUERY_STATUS contains OK and contains neither ERROR nor OVERFLOW
no missing site_elevation for any required overlap plate
site_name/lon/lat agree with frozen plate cache for all required overlap plates
iers_and_deltat: raw bytes retained and SHA256 recorded
reference date coverage includes all frozen overlap dates
uncertainty fields/availability recorded rather than assumed
software and dependency versions recorded at freeze

site_datum_qualification.certification_rule: The nominal calculation cannot by itself certify 2-arcsec physical precision when the site datum/accuracy is undocumented. Report site-datum status explicitly; do not promote to a new matcher solely from nominal recovery.
site_datum_qualification.documentation_fact: APPLAUSE DR4 provides site_longitude/site_latitude in degrees and site_elevation in metres, but does not document an explicit horizontal or vertical datum/accuracy in the plate-table schema.
site_datum_qualification.height_envelope_basis: Prospectively fixed conservative envelope from the documented global WGS84 EGM2008 geoid-undulation extrema (~-106.91 m to +85.82 m).
site_datum_qualification.nominal_geometry: Use the supplied lon/lat/elevation as nominal geodetic coordinates for the diagnostic transform only.

time_and_reference_conventions.bamberg: retain the previously frozen longitude/latitude swap; elevation is not swapped
time_and_reference_conventions.plate_time_scale: UT1, consistent with PyPlate handling of UT-derived observation times

workflow: Stage 0: verify v094q cache provenance and repair-only semantics
Stage 1: operational acquisition/preparation; resumable; no target geometry outcomes
Stage 2: freeze exact inputs, specification, executable, and dependency/reference versions
Stage 3: local geometry validation + observable synthetic recovery; no network
